statement: Pinned Dolphin emulates two 11-byte IR calibration EEPROM blocks at offsets 0x0000 and 0x000B containing packed coordinates for four points and a checksum byte. Only when no saved per-controller EEPROM image is loaded does its reset path synthesize one IR template and put it in both blocks. This is emulator fallback behavior, not retail calibration evidence.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: WiimoteEmu.h:257-265; WiimoteEmu.cpp:84,98-108 (saved-image selection),110-135 (synthetic fallback). No factory data copied.
